name: session-management
description: Runtime mods that keep a Claude Code session organized: unanswered questions, a shared task checklist, and the learnings Claude proposes for its memory.

judge.title: Question judge
judge.description: model: a small model decides which sentences are questions for you and which repeat an open one (any language). heuristic: local rules only, no model calls.

memory.title: Memory writes
memory.description: guard: Claude writes its memory only for what you accepted or a /learnings fix; any other write is refused and becomes a learning to review. observe: every write goes through, for /learnings doctor to review. off: memory is not watched and turns are not read for learnings.
